text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm visiting a chapel to help out
with a
school-sponsored photo shoot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a gorgeous chapel! I feel like I
could
meet a prince here!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
You have such a one-track mind...
Though I have
to agree, this place isn't
half bad.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
In any case, we're here as volunteers.
Don't get
distracted.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but of course! I'll make sure to work
hard
enough to earn my chance at
meeting a prince!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
You're helping out too, correct? It's
wonderful to
have a trainer on the team!
Welcome!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
And with that, the event begins.
However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This'll make for some great shots! Be a
dear and
pose a little!
text_block_list.name: Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
I already said no! Stop pointing the
camera at me!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be like that! I need you to
model for
me! Please!
text_block_list.name: Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
...What's this? I hear an ill-mannered
voice.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's that cameraman. He's ignoring
all the
rules.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Then I shall have to intervene. I'll save
you,
Dober!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Wait, Kawakami!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: HYAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: BAM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! Why is there a huge hole in
the
ground?!
text_block_list.name: Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
You there! Stop harassing Dober, or I'll
knock you
into next week!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! You
almost hit me
when yo—
text_block_list.name: Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
SILENCE! The price for angering a lady is
steep!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: If you do not cease this instant, well...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: CRRRRACK!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Eek! I-I'm sorry! I'll be going nowwww!
text_block_list.name: Cameraman

text_block_list.text:
The photographer flees the scene at the
sight of
Kawakami Princess's righteous
might.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Kawakami. If only I'd set
clearer
boundaries from the start...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
No, you didn't do anything wrong,
Dober. I'll
always be here if you ever
need me! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Okay, now, where were we? Right! Back
to work
so I can meet my prince!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
So you can meet your prince, huh?
Admirable,
but I don't think how you
meet will matter all that
much.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh? What do you mean by that, I
wonder?
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Well, now. If you're curious, why not ask
that
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Based on seeing what Каваками Принцесс
did just
now, I believe...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Your prince will be the one to find you.
You may just become a prince yourself.

text_block_list.text:
Based on seeing what Каваками Принцесс
did just
now, I believe...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Your prince will be the one to find you.
You may just become a prince yourself.

text_block_list.text:
I tell Каваками Принцесс that her many
wonderful
and unique quirks will have
princes flocking her
way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, really?! My charm will attract my
suitor?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
But what quirks do I have? I wish to hear
more,
King!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Um, quirks? Uh...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I want to know everything! I need
details! What
are these charms of mine?!
Where are they?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Why are you asking me?! Ask the trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Wow! I've never thought about that!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I can't really picture it, but a princess
should
always be open-minded!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I'd love to try being a prince at least
once!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
So I'll need your help, King. Let's walk
down the
aisle together!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to be there for my royal
debut as a
princess—no—as a prince!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: F-fine! Just put your fists away!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, one day I'll be a princess
walking like this
beside my prince. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, so in the end, you're a princess.
Well, that
role does suit you better.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Каваками Принцесс certainly has big
dreams for
the future. I feel certain that
she has what it takes
to find her perfect
prince someday.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
